(2) She pulls out a yellowed notebook page featuring handwritten Chinese lyrics and a pasted photo of actors. She holds the page close to the camera, pointing at a specific male actor in a school uniform with her fingers, showing a nostalgic smile. (3) The camera focuses on the scrapbook as she flips through multiple pages filled with magazine clippings, posters, and stickers of the same male actor (Joseph Cheng). She laughs and covers her mouth with her hand, appearing amused and embarrassed by her old collection. (4) She continues to show various larger posters and newspaper clippings she has preserved in the notebook, flipping them quickly to show the volume of the collection. The setting remains the same with bright, flat indoor lighting. (5) The video concludes with several high-quality still photographs showing the woman and the actor posing together in a dimly lit, purple-toned event venue, making peace signs and heart gestures.
